items.informal_name: Submodule Membership from Ideal Generation and Scalar Multiples
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (M' : Submodule R M)
  (s : Set R), Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (x : M), (∀ (r : ↑s), ↑r • x ∈ M') → x ∈ M'
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring, $ M $ an $ R $-module, and $ M' \subseteq M $ a submodule. If $ S \subseteq R $ is a set such that the ideal generated by $ S $ equals $ R $, and for every $ s \in S $ the scalar multiple $ s \cdot x $ lies in $ M' $, then the element $ x $ itself belongs to $ M' $.

items.informal_name: Submodule Membership via Ideal Span and Scalar Powers
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (M' : Submodule R M) (s : Set R), Ideal.span s = ⊤ → ∀ (x : M), (∀ (r : ↑s), ∃ n, ↑r ^ n • x ∈ M') → x ∈ M'
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring, $ M $ an $ R $-module, and $ M' \subseteq M $ a submodule. If $ s \subseteq R $ is a set with $ \langle s \rangle = R $ (the ideal generated by $ s $ equals $ R $), and for every $ r \in s $ there exists $ n \in \mathbb{N} $ such that $ r^n \cdot x \in M' $, then $ x \in M' $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (I : Ideal R)
  [I.IsTwoSided] {ι : Type u_4} (s : Set ι) (f : ι → M) (x : M),
  x ∈ I • Submodule.span R (f '' s) ↔ ∃ a, ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : ↑s), a i ∈ I), (a.sum fun i c => c • f ↑i) = x
items.informal_description: For any set $\iota$, subset $s \subseteq \iota$, function $f : \iota \to M$, and element $x \in M$, the element $x$ belongs to the product $I \bullet \operatorname{span}_R(f(s))$ if and only if there exists a finitely supported function $a : s \to R$ such that each $a(i) \in I$ and $x = \sum_{i \in s} a(i) \cdot f(i)$.

items.informal_name: Membership in Ideal-Span Product iff Finite Linear Combination with Coefficients in Ideal
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M] (I : Ideal R)
  [I.IsTwoSided] {ι : Type u_4} (f : ι → M) (x : M),
  x ∈ I • Submodule.span R (Set.range f) ↔ ∃ a, ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : ι), a i ∈ I), (a.sum fun i c => c • f i) = x
items.informal_description: For any type $\iota$, function $f : \iota \to M$, and element $x \in M$, the element $x$ belongs to the product of an ideal $I$ and the span of the set $\{f(i) \mid i \in \iota\}$ if and only if there exists a finite support function $a : \iota \to_0 R$ with coefficients in $I$ such that $x$ equals the finite sum $\sum_{i} a(i) \cdot f(i)$.

  (rs : List R), ⊤ = Ideal.ofList (r :: rs) • ⊤ ↔ ⊤ = Ideal.ofList rs • ⊤
items.informal_description: The entire module $ M $ is equal to the ideal generated by $ r $ and $ rs $ multiplied by $ M $ if and only if the entire quotient module $ M / (rM) $ is equal to the ideal generated by $ rs $ multiplied by $ M / (rM) $.

items.informal_name: Nakayama's Lemma Variant for Finitely Generated Submodules
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : Module R M] {I : Ideal R}
  {N N' P : Submodule R M}, N'.FG → N' ≤ P → P ≤ N ⊔ I • N' → ∃ r, r - 1 ∈ I ∧ r • P ≤ N
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring, $ M $ an $ R $-module, and $ I $ an ideal of $ R $. Suppose $ N, N', P $ are submodules of $ M $ such that $ N' $ is finitely generated, $ N' \subseteq P $, and $ P \subseteq N + I \cdot N' $. Then there exists an element $ r \in R $ such that $ r - 1 \in I $ and $ r \cdot P \subseteq N $.

  [I.IsTwoSided] {s : Set M} {x : M}, x ∈ I • Submodule.span R s ↔ x ∈ Submodule.span R (↑I • s)
items.informal_description: An element $ x $ belongs to the product of an ideal $ I $ and the span of a set $ s $ if and only if $ x $ belongs to the span of the set $ I \cdot s $, where $ I $ is an ideal in a semiring $ R $, $ s $ is a subset of an $ R $-module $ M $, and $ I \cdot s $ denotes the set of all products $ r \cdot m $ for $ r \in I $ and $ m \in s $.
